name: Ren Muwabia
source:
Age Unknown, probably about 27~28?
Image Stone: Obsidian, Silver

The leader of the Imperial Guard, a swordsman that uses dark magic. He opposes the 'Sacred Maidens'.
He has a dark air about him that makes him seem hard to approach, but he has a nice smile and a sociable side.
A mysterious guy who doesn't have many acquaintances. He lives to protect the royal family and the country.
